name: 19602 · Reading, PA
findings: ZIP 19602 (Reading) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19602 (Reading) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19602 (Reading) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
